text:
ashley: Quick design question—should the left axis show "requests/s" or "rps" (short) by default? Designers want consistent abbreviations across console.

kevin: prefer "rps" in cramped places, but full "requests/sec" in tooltips. risk: confusion with "reqs" elsewhere.

maria: Accessibility note: screen readers may read "r p s" if we use "rps". Should add aria-label that expands it: `aria-label="requests per second (rps)"`.

oliver: Agree with aria-label. Also think about switching the axis between "absolute" and "relative (%) of peak". We had ask from customerSRE.

ashley: If we add a small toggle "Absolute / % of peak" next to axis, how will it behave with heatmap color scale? Should color scale normalize when % selected?

kevin: Implementation note: normalizing heatmap requires recomputing buckets per query range. It's doable but expensive for wide ranges. Maybe disable normalization for >7d ranges and show tooltip: "Normalization disabled for long ranges".

maria: Copy suggestion for the toggle: "View as % of peak" (label), tooltip: "Normalize series to their peak value in the selected time window".

ashley: Also UX question — p95 tooltip currently shows "p95: 240ms". Can we make it "p95 latency: 240 ms (± sample error)" when sampling is on? We need to communicate sampling uncertainty.

oliver: For sampling microcopy consider: small italic line under chart "Sampling enabled — results may vary. Learn more: https://docs.redwood.com/sampling".

kevin: Keyboard nav: suggestions for +/- to zoom time range and left/right arrows for stepping by selected window. Accessibility tested?

maria: We should add focusable buttons and announce "Chart zoomed to 30m window" to SR. Example ARIA live: `role="status" aria-live="polite"`.

ashley: Small CSS/layout ask: the axis label wraps awkwardly in narrow panels. Could we rotate to 90deg or abbreviate? Rotating hurts readability.

oliver: Proposal: truncate with ellipsis and show full on hover + accessible tooltip. That avoids rotation.

kevin: Quick mock needed for console—I'll push updated spec to Figma later today. Any objections to copy and aria strings above?

maria: No objections. +1 on aria-label expansion and status announcer.

ashley: OK will update the design ticket and add the microcopy. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
